title: Complete Guide to Kubernetes Ingress
description: Kubernetes Ingress manifests from the guide: single-service and path-based routing, virtual hosting, TLS with cert-manager, common ingress-nginx annotations, canary deployments, and production hardening (PDB, NetworkPolicy).
description_es: Manifiestos de Kubernetes Ingress de la guía: enrutamiento por servicio y por path, virtual hosting, TLS con cert-manager, anotaciones comunes de ingress-nginx, despliegues canary y endurecimiento en producción (PDB, NetworkPolicy).
